references.text: Abimelek divided his people into groups to set an ambush, reflecting the same military tactic described in verse 34
Israel set an ambush around Gibeah, a similar military strategy of placing troops in hiding for a surprise attack
Joshua used an ambush against Ai, the same tactic that Abimelek used against Shechem
Joshua placed an ambush at night, like Abimelek's nighttime maneuver against Shechem
Saul set an ambush in the valley, another instance of military ambush tactics resembling Abimelek's strategy
